Image2 unchanged original small card controls pose, hair, clothes, crop and light. Image3 mascot identity and round anatomy only. Correct ONLY yellow lower jaw and its collar contact. The present yellow chin still ends in a downward triangular point between white collar tips. Remove that triangle. Finish the head in a BROAD ROUND SHORT U, with a wide softly curved near-horizontal base just below closed mouth, not two diagonal edges converging at a point. Raise and broaden the white shirt neckline around this wide rounded base; maintain coherent rear/front collar contact and shadow with minimal exposed throat. No separate neck, yellow shaft, pointed V funnel, pinched neckline, rolls, floating or clipping cloth, or cream belly bib. Preserve actual short dark upper-lip moustache and smooth chin, no beard. Preserve primary mild IMAGE-LEFT angle and head roll; do not turn frontal to hide the shape. Keep BROWN/MAROON OPEN coat and actual broad RED/BURGUNDY CRAVAT with folds, not a skinny long tie. Preserve exact actual source appearance: BAREHEADED short DARK BROWN/GREY combed side-parted receding hair with grey temples and real eyebrow HAIR, actual short DARK upper-lip MOUSTACHE and smooth clean chin, serious CLOSED mouth. BROWN/MAROON OPEN civilian coat, actual WHITE/PALE high/wing shirt collar and broad RED/BURGUNDY CRAVAT/neck wrap with source folds, not a modern skinny long tie. Preserve exact primary mild IMAGE-LEFT angle/roll and grey photographic backing/light, note-limited crop and exposed fastening. No cap, spectacles, chin beard, military uniform or hidden accessories; fine hair/cravat texture understated. Keep complete tilted dark frame, OPAQUE grey photographic backing and original cream lower-right note overlap. All solid head/hair/cloth/backing/note remain opaque; genuine exterior alpha only. No invented readable text, hidden medals or new accessories.
Output alpha: genuine transparent RGBA ONLY OUTSIDE the complete original framed portrait silhouette. The photographic BACKING INSIDE the frame is a required OPAQUE surface: preserve its original background color and texture behind the character all the way to the inner frame rim. Never turn the gaps between frame and character into transparent holes or a window. Keep the actual frame angle and rim. Preserve an overlapping paper note, pin or other attachment ONLY when actually visible in this exact source; otherwise do not invent one. Do not invent a new backdrop outside the whole card. Retain source clothing, hair, headgear, lighting and crop at full generated resolution. All originally OPAQUE subject surfaces must remain FULLY OPAQUE (alpha 255): yellow head/body, hair, beard, dark or black clothing, coat lapels, collar, tie, buttons and decorations. Dark cloth is colored material, not transparent background. Never fade garment interiors into semi-transparent patches, holes, white haze or see-through fabric. Keep any genuine source outer-edge alpha falloff only at that actual exterior boundary; preserve actual source transparency rather than making the subject itself translucent.
